summary: Meera can put Rs 20,000 a month towards her three debts: which first, and when is she debt-free?
split_note: Discovery (D53): v1's traces on this task are where prompt v2's changes may come from.

messages.content: I can put about ₹20,000 a month towards my debts. Which one should I pay off first, and when will I be debt-free?

graders.description: Floor only: the card is mentioned. Whether it is recommended first is the judge's criterion.
Open coding plus yes/no criteria (D53); optional until the rubric is written and the criteria pass the trust bar (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the answer recommend paying off the 42% credit card first, before the personal loan and the two-wheeler loan? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Avalanche order: ['Credit card', 'Personal loan', 'Two-wheeler loan']. Judgment: kind about her mother's costs; a plan she can follow.
